First of all, find a sensitivity low enough that makes it easier to follow heads. Most players play somewhere from 1.5 to 3 with their DPI kept at default (around 400). When I first started playing the game, I used to play at 7 or even 8 sensitivity, and that was the first key issue I later realized.

Now you need to know the proper way to use assault rifles. As you surely know, you have to stop before shooting, but that doesn't mean that you can't move or strafe to make it easier for you to adjust the crosshair onto the opponent's head as opposed to purely using mouse movement. When you want to stop, tap the movement key opposite to the direction you're moving, then fire the rifle. This may seem impractical, but if you practice it enough in deathmatch, it will become second nature. This is also essential for mastering the pistol.

Now the third thing you need to know is what shooting technique you should use. Spraying is secondary, and the pattern for the rifles is intuitive. I only spray in close-range combat, or if I'm being flanked and don't have enough time to adjust aim, then I go for crouch spray. For close-range combat, aim at the head and spray; you don't need to crouch. Start pulling down after two to three bullets. Of course, if you get the kill from the first or second bullet, then you stop spraying, but the spraying is to guarantee that you get the kill as reliably as possible. For medium-range combat, use two to three bullet bursts with one rifle, and taps/two bullet bursts with the other. I personally think this is the most reliable way to get kills at medium range; it's more reliable and efficient than crouch spraying. For long-range, never ever spray; use taps for one rifle, and bursts/taps for the other.

I recommend you use one variant of the rifle instead of the other, because it is a much stronger match to the opposing rifle; it has a higher fire rate with an insignificant difference in accuracy.

You can search for a well-known player's video online; he teaches you how to shoot with the rifle. One time I read on a professional player's Reddit AMA that you can reach a high rank without having that good of an aim as long as you have very good game sense, so don't be discouraged if your aim isn't so good.

About countering people who run and gun, it's just something that will disappear after you leave the lower ranks. But you can try not to stand in a wide open position; if you do that, they will have an advantage over you because they will have faster reaction time than you will since they are the ones entering. Also, run and gun is only great for close range; rifles are great at all ranges, so if you use range advantage, you should have an edge.

this is an old but still useful video to give you an idea of what a popular tactical shooter game is about, I recommend you watch it https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jdPBKFV1840

=======

this tactical shooter is a difficult game for many reasons, some basic reasons are:

-you do not have the bird's eye view of the battlefield as you do in multiplayer online battle arena and real-time strategy games, 

-the weapons have inaccuracies depending on distance (close, medium, long); sidearms and submachine guns are effective at close and medium ranges, while rifles are effective at all ranges.

-the weapons also have inaccuracies while moving; sidearms and submachine guns have lower inaccuracies, allowing for more movement while shooting, but rifles have a high moving inaccuracy, so you need to stop moving before shooting.

-economy: when you die, you only re-spawn with a weak sidearm, and you need to use in-game currency to buy all the equipment you want.

=========

there are many weapons in the game; to make it simpler, I will tell you the most fundamental ones you need to learn how to use by playing a free-for-all mode:

-sidearms: five-seven, tec-9

-rifles: ak47, m4, awp

-submachine gun: ump45 is the best submachine gun, but the others are still very good, except the one called bizon, which is not effective.

=========

misc. tips

-use a sensitivity setting somewhere from 1.5 to 3.5 under default DPI (400)

-don't spray weapons from long range; use taps or bursts at most.

-here's a tutorial on modifying your crosshair https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5CzqbH3GB6s

-running makes footstep noises that are audible to enemies; walking is silent.

-running with a knife is the fastest way to move. walking with a knife is the fastest way to walk. you can show speed by typing in console cl_showpos 1

-having high frames per second is very important; use low or very low shadow and shader video options. the effect detail and texture detail can be left at high.
